test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an artificial port in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai port**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chennai Port** is an artificial and one of the largest ports in India, located in Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is the **second largest port in India** in terms of cargo handling and is known for its modern infrastructure.
 
• Originally called **Madras Port**, it is the oldest artificial port on the East Coast of India.
 
• The port was established in the 19th century and continues to play a major role in India's maritime trade.
 
• It primarily handles a wide range of cargo, including containers, automobiles, and liquid cargo.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Artificial Port:** A port constructed by human intervention, as opposed to natural harbors that form naturally along coastlines.
 
• **Natural Ports in India:** Examples include Mumbai Port, Marmagao Port, and Cochin Port, which are located in naturally sheltered areas.
 
• **Chennai Port’s Connectivity:** It is well-connected to inland areas via railways and roadways, making it a key trade hub in South India.
 
• **Deendayal Port:** Located in Gujarat, it is a natural port, formerly known as Kandla Port, and plays a significant role in India's trade.
 
• **Kolkata Port:** Though an important port, it is a riverine port and not an artificial one like Chennai Port.
